listing.name: The Need for Speed (3DO) — pc-theneedforspeed (vs-sr-dev)

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: 3DO TheNeedforSpeed own originaldisc,LaunchMe/frontovl/LMADM/FORMAT. Keep your original game files separately. The recorded source review did not download or run the game.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Own-disc extraction/ARMstatic generation/CMake pfboot; blank NVRAM formatted by your own FORMAT, --window. These are manual setup instructions. Portcove does not manage this download or confirm setup or gameplay.
